id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17a8: "{var:1}, are you ready to fight Rab?
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|184c: "I see. Being cautious is good. Rab is no pushover now. Tell me when you're ready.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a24: "{var:1}, let me get a good look at you again...
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ac4: "Heh heh... You're gentle and kind, yet stubborn and slow to give up. You're the spitting image of young Rab.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b9c: "I worried about you for sixteen years since I heard Dundrasil fell. But seeing you now, I needn't have.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c80: "I thought my life was nearly over, but I lived to see your face. It pays to live long.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d5c: "...Oops, sorry. This is no time for idle talk. We have to make up for lost training all at once.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e54: "Now talk to Sampo and take on the Warrior's Gauntlet! With Angri-La's finest training, I'll drive you hard!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20d4: "Now talk to Sampo and take on the Warrior's Gauntlet! With Angri-La's finest training, I'll drive you hard!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fb8: "I'd love to talk more with my dear pupil, but this is no time for idle talk. We must make up for lost training.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|224c: "What's wrong, {var:1}? The Warrior's Gauntlet has only just begun. Giving up this soon won't do.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2318: "Even if you fail once, don't give up. Take on the trials again and again. One day you'll surely overcome them.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2418: "The Luminary of old, Erdwin, trained and grew that way too. Don't you lose either.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2590: "Well done, {var:1}! The training no one has reached in hundreds of years, the Gauntlet of Valor Extreme, is finally open!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26a0: "The trials from here on bring enemies stronger than any you've faced. But never give up.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2788: "If you show the true strength you've built through your hard adventures, you'll surely overcome them.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2900: "Well done, {var:1}! Clearing Angri-La's final trial is a feat unseen since Luminary Erdwin!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29e8: "Having survived my harsh training, there's nothing you can't do. Fulfill your Luminary's duty with confidence.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2adc: "...But if you want to train again, come right back. I'll take you on anytime.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c6c: "{var:1}, are you ready to head to the Underworld?
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e38: "{var:1}, are you ready to head to the Underworld?
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d10: "You never know what will happen in the Underworld. I recommend praying at the Goddess statue right over there.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3068: "You never know what will happen in the Underworld. I recommend praying at the Goddess statue right over there.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2edc: "Understood. Then I will perform the spirit-division ritual and send you to the Underworld once more.

id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|35e8: "Still, it's noisy outside the palace. What on earth happened...

id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|40f0: "Luminary, you're awake. Lord Rab was battered too, but his life was never in danger.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4198: "Anyway, I'm truly glad everyone returned safely.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4248: "I hear Lord Rab is still collecting naughty books. Spirited even in old age, I'm relieved.

id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4364: "Ah, memories. Long ago, Lord Rab and I read naughty books together and got scolded harshly by Master Nima.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4f44: "Ah, memories. Long ago, Lord Rab and I read naughty books together and got scolded harshly by Master Nima.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4424: "...Oh dear. Thinking we can no longer be scolded together by the Master, tears have come.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4afc: "Perhaps Lord Rab defeated the Dark One thanks to the focus he gained reading naughty books. Be grateful to them... ha ha.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4c40: "Luminary Erdwin defeated the evil god because he was blessed with excellent allies, such as the wizard Uranos.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d1c: "You defeated the Dark One for the same reason: excellent allies. Never forget to be grateful to your friends.

id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5734: "I'm Angri-La's assistant instructor. Had Dundrasil not fallen, I'd have trained you alongside Master Nima.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|580c: "I'd like to teach you our ways at once, but please first hear the High Priest. The training ground lies beyond the palace.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5964: "I leave the trainee to you. I should go help, but as assistant instructor I must guard the village.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5a4c: "I'm sorry to ask right after you arrived. With monsters more violent than ever, you're the only one we can rely on.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5ba0: "{var:1}, I heard. You trained under the Master in the Underworld. You endured that harsh training well.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5c78: "I meant to train you too, but it seems unnecessary now. Keep up the good work and push on even further.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5de4: "Then let's begin... but you have the duty of defeating the Dark One. Train after that is done.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5ef4: "What?! You think you can beat the Dark One like that?! The Master would give you a whack with the spanking stick!

id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|62c4: "Then let's begin... but now we should rejoice in the world's peace. You can train anytime.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|63c4: "What! Even after saving the world, training never ends! The Master would whack you with the spanking stick!

id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6614: "The Luminary trained by the Master defeated the Dark One, so our forebears' aim was a perfect hit.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|673c: "The Warrior's Gauntlet is an old training, but hardly anyone has fully conquered it. If you take it on, prepare well.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6b9c: "Welcome, Prince of Dundrasil. Since I heard Dundrasil fell, I've worried about you the whole time.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6c64: "Some said you had died, but the Master believed you were safe. So the Master was never wrong.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6d90: "You pushed yourself hard to help the trainee who headed to the summit.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6e20: "But your injuries are light, and I'm nursing you, so don't worry. I leave the trainee to you.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6f24: "I hear High Priest Sampo and Lord Rab are waiting in front of the palace. Why not go greet them?
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|703c: "The reason I've endured this harsh training for twenty years is to master a secret art of our village.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7484: "The reason I've endured this harsh training for twenty years is to master a secret art of our village.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7108: "The unrivaled secret technique Luminary Erdwin favored... the Overlord slash! Don't you want to learn it too?

id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7210: "Of course. But even for a Luminary, learning it right away is impossible. Even twenty years haven't been enough for me.

id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7e24: "Without her, we'd be... I can't waste this life she saved.

id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|944c: "But even Heliodor feared the Master and never attacked. That's how great her power was.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9554: "...Urp. I drank too much last night and I'm hungover, but I'm managing to dance. If I skip training, the High Priest will scold me.

id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9a04: "You climbed a monster-ridden mountain path and went to the Underworld to rescue Lord Rab... I've seen your true strength.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9ed4: "When the Dark One's castle floating in the sky crumbled, everyone in the village gathered here to watch.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9fc8: "When Yggdrasil was revived, a huge cheer went up. I wish you could have heard it.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a0ac: "Phew... the world is at peace. It won't hurt to rest from training and lie down for a bit.

id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|afec: "I seem to lack talent for dancing, but I won't give up easily. I'll definitely become a full-fledged monk.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b0ec: "You can see Yggdrasil through the gap in the mountains. That beautiful tree revived all thanks to you.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b1f4: "Mom... I'll train more and more, and become a monk as fine as the Luminary.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b4f0: "Mom... I won't lose. I won't run away, no matter how hard. I'll protect everyone in the village.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b6b4: "Ahead lies Angri-La's Grand Training Ground. Many trainees forge themselves in this sacred place. Proceed with care.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b7f0: "Last night's feast was fun. There's been so much sad news lately, so I'm glad everyone enjoyed it from the heart.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b934: "I too was often hit with the spanking stick by the Master when young, but I couldn't beat Lord Rab's record of ten thousand.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ba10: "Ha ha, that shows how outstanding Lord Rab is. You may be proud as his grandchild.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|baec: "So the trainee who headed for the summit was Lord Rab, the Master's first disciple.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bb88: "And he even went to the Underworld to learn Angri-La's secret art... As expected of the legendary disciple.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bc7c: "If you'd spoken with Master Nima, you'd know she always thought of her disciples. She was full of compassion.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bd68: "That prickly attitude was all a flip side of her love for her disciples.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|be30: "To defeat the Dark One, who had power enough to destroy Yggdrasil... well done. As a fellow disciple of Master Nima, I'm proud.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bfa0: "Did you know? The legendary disciple, Lord Rab, was spanked ten thousand times in six years under the Master.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c08c: "Ha ha, that shows how outstanding Lord Rab is. You may be proud as his grandchild.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c234: "This is Angri-La's historic Grand Training Ground. Welcome, Prince of Dundrasil. The High Priest awaits in the mausoleum there.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c358: "This is Angri-La's historic Grand Training Ground. Welcome, Prince of Dundrasil. The High Priest awaits at its center.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c490: "This is Angri-La's historic Grand Training Ground. Trainees' blood and sweat have soaked these ancient grounds.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c5d0: "This is Angri-La's historic Grand Training Ground. Trainees' blood and sweat have soaked these ancient grounds.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c710: "This is Angri-La's historic Grand Training Ground. Trainees' blood and sweat have soaked these ancient grounds.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c850: "This is Angri-La's historic Grand Training Ground. Welcome, Prince of Dundrasil. The Master awaits at its center.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ca78: "My friend Sampo is the High Priest. He's second only to the Master, and now he's everyone's teacher.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cb24: "He's still a kid like me, but Sampo is amazing. I could never do what he does.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d1d4: "He's still a kid like me, but Sampo is amazing. I could never do what he does.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cbdc: "Oh, Luminary, good morning. The Angri-La dishes at the feast were delicious. One of the world's three great cuisines!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ccec: "My friend Sampo rules the village as High Priest. He's still a kid, but it's amazing.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cd84: "...But the other day I saw him crying alone. The Master who was like his parent died. He acts tough, but he must be sad.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ce8c: "Oh, Luminary, listen! I saw Lord Rab's face for the first time. So he's the famous legendary disciple.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cfa0: "My friend Sampo is the High Priest. It's amazing for a kid.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d00c: "He's a kid, so I'm sure there will be hardships ahead, but I'll support him, so don't worry.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d110: "My friend Sampo is the High Priest. He's second to the Master and trains people older than him.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d2a8: "My friend Sampo seems to be helping beside the Master. He looked very happy.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d350: "To Sampo, the Master is like a parent, so just being with her makes him glad.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d520: "Welcome, Luminary. This is the Master's Chamber, where past Masters lived. The late Master Nima also lived here.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d614: "Had you become her disciple, you might have slept and woken here.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|deec: "Had you become her disciple, you might have slept and woken here.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d6dc: "Good morning, Luminary. Did you enjoy last night's feast?
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d760: "All we can do is treat you, weary from your long journey, so please rest as long as you like.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d858: "...What was Master Nima like? She was gentle and refined. Her disciples adored her.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d934: "No one disliked her. If you had met her, I'm sure you'd have liked her too.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|da24: "Good morning, Luminary! When I saw you pass out yesterday I worried, but you look fine.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|daf8: "High Priest Sampo and Lord Rab are waiting outside the palace for you. Please show them your face soon.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dbdc: "The Master waited for you all along. Even if only briefly, I'm sure she was happy to meet you.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dcd4: "Luminary, well done defeating the Dark One. Master Nima is surely delighted in Heaven to see her beloved disciple's feat.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|de00: "Welcome, Luminary. This is the Master's Chamber, where past Masters lived. The current Master, Nima, lives here too.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|df98: "The Master waited for you all along. She must be so happy to take you as her disciple.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e18c: "We showed terribly rude behavior toward the Luminary we should have welcomed warmly. Please forgive us.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e254: "The High Priest wishes to speak with you. Please go up to the Master's palace above.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e370: "You're heading to the summit of Mount Pang Lai. The mountain path lies east of the village.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e448: "You're heading to the summit of Mount Pang Lai. The mountain path lies east, outside the cave leading to the village.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e54c: "Strong monsters are said to roam the mountain path. If you get hurt, return to the village and rest.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e650: "I keep watch so dangerous monsters can't enter the village. As long as I stand here, it's safe.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e7a4: "When Yggdrasil fell, a shock wave hit. Master Nima gave her life to put up a powerful barrier and protect this village.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e8f0: "...Luminary, you defeated the Dark One. Thank you for avenging the Master.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e9ec: "That appearance... Could you be Prince {var:1} of Dundrasil?
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|eaac: "...Oh, I knew it! Master Nima saw the Luminary's star fall and said your visit was near.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|eb78: "The Master awaited meeting you for sixteen years. Please go see her.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ee18: "The Master awaited meeting you for sixteen years. Please go see her.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ec40: "The Master is at the Grand Training Ground deep in the palace above.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|eee0: "The Master is at the Grand Training Ground deep in the palace above.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ed54: "What are you saying! The prince's dignity overflowing from your whole body... you must be the Luminary!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|efd8: "How is the Warrior's Gauntlet going? You can take it at the Grand Training Ground behind the Master's palace.

tm.「{var:1}\n ロウと戦う準備は できたかい？: "{var:1}, are you ready to fight Rab?
tm.「そうかい。まあ 用心深いのはいいことだ。\n 今のロウは ひと筋縄じゃいかない: "I see. Being cautious is good. Rab is no pushover now. Tell me when you're ready.
tm.「{var:1} 改めて\n よく カオを見せておくれ……。: "{var:1}, let me get a good look at you again...
tm.「ふふふ……もの柔らかで 優しそうなところも\n ガンコで あきらめが 悪そうな: "Heh heh... You're gentle and kind, yet stubborn and slow to give up. You're the spitting image of young Rab.
tm.「１６年前 ユグノアが滅びたと聞いてから\n ずっと アンタの身を 案じていたけ: "I worried about you for sixteen years since I heard Dundrasil fell. But seeing you now, I needn't have.
tm.「でも あたいの寿命も そろそろかと思ったけど\n 生きて アンタのカオを 見ら: "I thought my life was nearly over, but I lived to see your face. It pays to live long.
tm.「……おっと すまない。\n 今は ムダ話をしてる場合じゃない。\n 遅れた分の: "...Oops, sorry. This is no time for idle talk. We have to make up for lost training all at once.
tm.「さあ サンポと話して 連武討魔行に挑戦しな！\n ドゥルダに伝わる とっておき: "Now talk to Sampo and take on the Warrior's Gauntlet! With Angri-La's finest training, I'll drive you hard!
tm.「かわいい弟子と もっと話していたいけど\n 今は ムダ話をしてる場合じゃない。: "I'd love to talk more with my dear pupil, but this is no time for idle talk. We must make up for lost training.
tm.「どうしたんだい {var:1}。\n 連武討魔行は まだ 始まったばかり。\n: "What's wrong, {var:1}? The Warrior's Gauntlet has only just begun. Giving up this soon won't do.
tm.「一度失敗しても あきらめないで\n 何度も何度も 試練に挑戦するんだ。\n そ: "Even if you fail once, don't give up. Take on the trials again and again. One day you'll surely overcome them.
tm.「先代の勇者 ローシュも\n そうやって修行して 成長したんだからね。\n アン: "The Luminary of old, Erdwin, trained and grew that way too. Don't you lose either.
tm.「{var:1} よくやった！\n 何百年もの間 誰も到達できなかった修行……\: "Well done, {var:1}! The training no one has reached in hundreds of years, the Gauntlet of Valor Extreme, is finally open!
tm.「ここから先の試練では これまでとは\n 比べものにならないほど 強い敵が現れる: "The trials from here on bring enemies stronger than any you've faced. But never give up.
tm.「厳しい冒険の中で つちかった\n アンタたちの 本当の実力を発揮すれば\n 必: "If you show the true strength you've built through your hard adventures, you'll surely overcome them.
tm.「{var:1} よくやった！\n ドゥルダの最終試練を 乗り越えるなんて\n: "Well done, {var:1}! Clearing Angri-La's final trial is a feat unseen since Luminary Erdwin!
tm.「あたいの厳しい修行を乗り越えた\n アンタに できないことはない。\n 自信を: "Having survived my harsh training, there's nothing you can't do. Fulfill your Luminary's duty with confidence.
tm.「……でも もう一度 修行したくなったら\n ここに 遠慮なく 戻ってくるといい: "...But if you want to train again, come right back. I'll take you on anytime.
tm.「{var:1}さん\n 冥府に向かう準備が できましたか？: "{var:1}, are you ready to head to the Underworld?
tm.「冥府では 何が 起こるかわかりません。\n すぐそこにある 女神像で\n お祈: "You never know what will happen in the Underworld. I recommend praying at the Goddess statue right over there.
tm.「わかりました。\n では これより 分霊の儀式を行い\n もう一度 あなたを冥: "Understood. Then I will perform the spirit-division ritual and send you to the Underworld once more.
tm.サンポ大僧正が 踊りを始めると\n徐々に {var:1}の気が遠くなっていった。:
As High Priest Sampo began to dance,
{var:1}'s consciousness slowly faded.
tm.「うううっ……すまん。\n 勇者さまに会えたことは うれしいが\n 亡くなった: "Uuugh... Sorry. I'm glad to meet the Luminary, but when I think of the late Master's feelings...
tm.「大師は 勇者さまの訪れを心待ちにしていた。\n 立派に育った あなたのカオを\: "The Master was eagerly awaiting the Luminary's visit. I wish I could have shown her how well you grew up...
tm.「勇者さま 昨日は ぐっすり眠れたようじゃな。\n また 旅に出られると聞いて\: "Luminary, it seems you slept soundly last night. The High Priest is waiting outside to see you off.
tm.「それにしても 宮殿の外が なにやら騒がしいが\n いったい 何が あったのかの: "Still, it's noisy outside the palace. What on earth happened...
tm.「勇者ローシュと 魔法使いウラノスは\n 最初から 仲がよかったわけではない。: "Luminary Erdwin and the wizard Uranos weren't friends from the start.
tm.「むしろ ライバルのような関係で\n 一度 どちらが強いか確かめるため\n この: "They were more like rivals, and once fought a duel at this village's training ground to see who was stronger.
tm.「互角のチカラを持った ふたりの戦いは\n 三日三晩続いても 決着がつかず\n: "Their powers were equal. After three days and nights of battle there was no victor, and the fight ended in a draw...
tm.「互いのチカラを認め合った ふたりは\n その後 無二の親友になったらしい。\n: "Having recognized each other's strength, the two became inseparable friends. Heh heh, quite a heartwarming tale.
tm.「大きなチカラを持つ者は\n 得てして 孤独におちいりやすい。: "Those with great power tend to fall into loneliness.
tm.「互いを認め合うほどの 友と巡りあえた\n ローシュと ウラノスは\n 幸せじゃ: "Erdwin and Uranos may have been happy to meet a friend who truly acknowledged them.
tm.「勇者さま 目が覚めたようじゃな。\n ロウさまも ボロボロだったが\n 命に別: "Luminary, you're awake. Lord Rab was battered too, but his life was never in danger.
tm.「なにはともあれ\n 皆が 無事に戻ることができて\n 本当に よかったわい。: "Anyway, I'm truly glad everyone returned safely.
tm.「聞いたところによると ロウ殿は\n まだ ムフフ本を 集めているそうじゃな。\: "I hear Lord Rab is still collecting naughty books. Spirited even in old age, I'm relieved.
tm.「なつかしいのう。\n 昔 ロウ殿と一緒に ムフフ本を見ては\n ニマ大師に こ: "Ah, memories. Long ago, Lord Rab and I read naughty books together and got scolded harshly by Master Nima.
tm.「……いかんいかん。もう 大師に\n ふたりで 怒られることもないと思うと\n: "...Oh dear. Thinking we can no longer be scolded together by the Master, tears have come.
tm.「魔王を倒せたのも ロウ殿が ムフフ本を読んで\n 集中力を高めたおかげかもしれ: "Perhaps Lord Rab defeated the Dark One thanks to the focus he gained reading naughty books. Be grateful to them... ha ha.
tm.「勇者ローシュが 邪悪の神を倒せたのは\n 魔法使いウラノスをはじめとする\n: "Luminary Erdwin defeated the evil god because he was blessed with excellent allies, such as the wizard Uranos.
tm.「あなたが 魔王を倒せたのも\n 同じく すぐれた仲間に恵まれたからじゃろう。\: "You defeated the Dark One for the same reason: excellent allies. Never forget to be grateful to your friends.
tm.「……いかんいかん。昔を思いだして\n 涙が 出てきてしもうた。: "...Oh dear. Remembering the past brought tears.
tm.「勇者ローシュと 魔法使いウラノスは\n 共に 邪悪の神を倒した 仲間だったが\: "Luminary Erdwin and the wizard Uranos both fought the evil god, but weren't friends from the start.
tm.「私は ドゥルダ郷の師範代です。\n ユグノアが滅びなければ ニマ大師と共に\n: "I'm Angri-La's assistant instructor. Had Dundrasil not fallen, I'd have trained you alongside Master Nima.
tm.「さっそく 郷の教えを伝授したいのですが\n まずは 大僧正の話を聞いてください: "I'd like to teach you our ways at once, but please first hear the High Priest. The training ground lies beyond the palace.
tm.「修行者のことは あなたに まかせます。\n 本当は 私が 助けにいくべきですが: "I leave the trainee to you. I should go help, but as assistant instructor I must guard the village.
tm.「郷に来た矢先 申し訳ありませんが\n 以前よりも 魔物が凶暴化している今\n: "I'm sorry to ask right after you arrived. With monsters more violent than ever, you're the only one we can rely on.
tm.「{var:1}さま 聞きましたよ。\n 冥府で 大師の修行を受けたそうですね。: "{var:1}, I heard. You trained under the Master in the Underworld. You endured that harsh training well.
tm.「私も 稽古をつけるつもりでしたが\n もはや その必要もないでしょう。\n そ: "I meant to train you too, but it seems unnecessary now. Keep up the good work and push on even further.
tm.「では さっそく……と思いましたが\n あなたには 魔王を倒すという使命がありま: "Then let's begin... but you have the duty of defeating the Dark One. Train after that is done.
tm.「なんと！？ そんなことで\n 魔王を倒せると思っているのですか！？\n 大師な: "What?! You think you can beat the Dark One like that?! The Master would give you a whack with the spanking stick!
tm.「聞いた話によると ドゥルダとユグノアの交流は\n 世界が 邪悪の神におびやかさ: "I hear exchange between Angri-La and Dundrasil began in ancient times, when the world was threatened by the evil god.
tm.「思えば ユグノア王子が 修行する慣習も\n 歴代の大師とユグノア王が ふたたび: "Perhaps the custom of Dundrasil princes training here was made by past Masters and kings to prepare for the crisis's return.
tm.「では さっそく……と思いましたが\n 今は 世界の平和を よろこぶべきでしょう: "Then let's begin... but now we should rejoice in the world's peace. You can train anytime.
tm.「なんと！ 世界を救ったとしても\n 自己の修練は 永遠に続くのですよ！\n 大: "What! Even after saving the world, training never ends! The Master would whack you with the spanking stick!
tm.「ユグノア王子が 修行する慣習は\n 歴代の大師とユグノア王が ふたたび訪れる\: "The custom of Dundrasil princes training here was made by past Masters and kings to prepare for the world's crisis.
tm.「大師の修行を受けた\n 勇者さまが 魔王を倒したのですから\n 先人たちの狙い: "The Luminary trained by the Master defeated the Dark One, so our forebears' aim was a perfect hit.
tm.「連武討魔行は 古くから伝わる修行ですが\n 完全制覇した者は ほとんどいないそ: "The Warrior's Gauntlet is an old training, but hardly anyone has fully conquered it. If you take it on, prepare well.
tm.「よく いらっしゃいました ユグノアの王子よ。\n ユグノアが滅んだと 聞いたと: "Welcome, Prince of Dundrasil. Since I heard Dundrasil fell, I've worried about you the whole time.
tm.「あなたが死んだと言う者も いましたが\n 大師さまは あなたの無事を信じていま: "Some said you had died, but the Master believed you were safe. So the Master was never wrong.
tm.「山頂に向かった 修行者を助けるために\n かなり ムリをしたようですね。: "You pushed yourself hard to help the trainee who headed to the summit.
tm.「ですが ケガは 軽傷ですし\n 私が 看病しているので 心配はいりません。\n: "But your injuries are light, and I'm nursing you, so don't worry. I leave the trainee to you.
tm.「サンポ大僧正とロウさまが\n 宮殿の前で 待っていると聞きました。\n ごあい: "I hear High Priest Sampo and Lord Rab are waiting in front of the palace. Why not go greet them?
tm.「私が ２０年間\n この厳しい修行に たえてきたのは\n 郷に伝わる ある秘技: "The reason I've endured this harsh training for twenty years is to master a secret art of our village.
tm.「勇者ローシュが 愛用したという\n 空前絶後の秘奥義……その名も 覇王斬！\n: "The unrivaled secret technique Luminary Erdwin favored... the Overlord slash! Don't you want to learn it too?
tm.「そうでしょう。ですが いくら勇者さまといえど\n 今すぐに 習得するのは ムリ: "Of course. But even for a Luminary, learning it right away is impossible. Even twenty years haven't been enough for me.
tm.「えっ！？ もう習得したのですか！\n こっ これが 生まれ持った才能の差ですか: "What?! You've already mastered it! Is this the gap of natural talent? What were my twenty years for...
tm.「大師に教えてもらった 覇王斬。\n 魔王ウルノーガとの戦いでも 使いましたか？: "The Overlord slash the Master taught you. Did you use it against the Dark One Mordegon too?
tm.「そうですか！ ローシュが愛用した 秘奥義……\n 魔王との戦いでも さぞ 役に: "I see! The secret art Erdwin favored... it must have helped against the Dark One. I hope to learn it someday.
tm.「えっ！？ せっかく 秘奥義を習得したのに\n 肝心の魔王との戦いで 使わなかっ: "What?! You mastered the secret art but didn't use it against the Dark One! What a waste...
tm.「魔王が 命の大樹を落としたとき\n 大師さまは 自分の命と引き換えに\n 強力: "When the Dark One dropped Yggdrasil, the Master put up a powerful barrier at the cost of her life and protected the village.
tm.「大師さまがいなければ ボクたちは今頃……。\n 大師さまに 救ってもらったこの: "Without her, we'd be... I can't waste this life she saved.
tm.「……えっ 何をしてるかって？\n 見ての通り 修練場を走って 鍛えてるんだ。\: "...What am I doing? As you see, I'm running the training ground to build strength. This is my training.
tm.「修行を積みかさねて 強くなったら\n いつか 伝説の修行……連武討魔行に挑むん: "Once I've trained and grown strong, I'll take on the legendary trial, the Warrior's Gauntlet! I can't give up at this!
tm.「……えっ 何をしてるかって？\n 見ての通り 修練場を走って 鍛えてるのさ。\: "...What am I doing? As you see, I'm running the training ground to get stronger. This is my training.
tm.「この女の子 郷の外から来たんだって……。\n なんていうか……この郷では\n: "This girl says she's from outside the village... How do I put it... in this village, her outfit is unthinkable. So, so provocative...
tm.「だ…だめだ……。ボク 止まらないよ。\n さっきから ドキドキが 止まらないよ: "N-no good... I can't stop. My heart won't stop pounding. I've never felt my chest race like this...
tm.「……えっ 何をしてるかって？\n 見ての通り 修練場を走って 鍛えてるのさ！\: "...What am I doing? As you see, I'm running the training ground to get stronger! This is my training!
tm.「魔王を倒した 勇者さまとロウさまに\n ボクも 負けてなんかいられないよ！\n: "The Luminary and Lord Rab defeated the Dark One! I can't lose either! I'll run and run!
tm.「ユグノアと縁のある ドゥルダ郷は\n 悪魔の子に味方する郷として 長い間\n: "Angri-La, tied to Dundrasil, was long blockaded by Heliodor as a village siding with the Darkspawn.
